note: June 1-2 funding wave: Impulse Space ($500M Series D), Mach Industries ($300M Series C), Contraline ($92.5M Series B), plus delayed-indexed Pace ($46M insurtech Series B). Legal-freelance batch favors fund-side employers (Allocate, aVenture) plus one explicit fractional GC (Socket). No new pr-freelance entries cleared the 40-point floor today.

leads.name: Pace
leads.industry: AI agents for insurance operations — submissions, renewals, policy servicing, claims
leads.fundingStage: $46M Series B on 2026-05-27 co-led by Thrive Capital and Sequoia Capital; Emergence Capital and Pruven Capital participating. Prior $10M Series A from Sequoia (Jan 2026).
leads.source: fintech.global / The Insurer / citybiz / Tech Startups
leads.notes: Strongest insurtech-AI fit since Reserv. Sequoia + Thrive warm-intro paths. Named blue-chip insurance customers create credibility for an exec-comms + thought-leadership sprint.

leads.name: Mach Industries
leads.industry: Defense tech — autonomous vehicles (Viper, Glide, Stratos, Dart, Pike); Forge flexible manufacturing network
leads.fundingStage: $300M Series C at $1.8B valuation on 2026-06-01/02; led by Infinite Capital and Ribbit Capital; Sequoia Capital, Bedrock Capital, Khosla Ventures participating. Valuation 4x YoY.
leads.notes: Sequoia/Khosla/Ribbit warm-intro paths. Pentagon 'drone dominance' narrative is a textbook executive-comms moment. Use-of-proceeds names talent acquisition + product development + Forge expansion.

leads.name: Impulse Space
leads.industry: In-space mobility infrastructure — 'space tugs' for satellite orbit transfer
leads.fundingStage: $500M Series D at $4.26B valuation on 2026-06-02; co-led by 137 Ventures and BANNER VC; Founders Fund, Lux Capital, Linse Capital participating. Total raised >$1B.

contacts.name: Tom Mueller
contacts.title: Founder & CEO, Impulse Space (ex-SpaceX early employee)

leads.source: GlobeNewswire / SpaceNews / Capital Brief / Via Satellite
leads.notes: Founders Fund + Lux warm-intro paths. Tom Mueller's SpaceX heritage + 'last-mile of space' narrative is a media-rich exec-positioning angle. Space-economy infra borderline ICP but PR-grade story.

leads.name: Allocate — Senior Fund Formation Attorney (Remote)
leads.industry: Fund/secondaries fintech — private-markets allocation platform; long-open senior counsel seat
leads.employmentTypeRaw: Senior Fund Formation Attorney (W-2 senior; long-open)
leads.notes: W-2 senior posting but the 6-week open window creates a textbook fractional/interim pitch — Mark can pitch a 90-day bridge while Allocate continues their permanent search. Pure fund-formation ICP fit.

leads.name: Socket — Fractional General Counsel (Remote)
leads.industry: Tech security / supply-chain security — software-supply-chain platform for npm/Python; operating-company GC seat
leads.notes: Explicitly fractional + remote + active. Highest-intent engagement model in today's batch. Buyer is operating company rather than fund, which lowers fit-side score but the intent profile is strong enough to push past the floor easily.

leads.name: aVenture — Venture Capital Fund Attorney (Remote)
leads.industry: Venture capital platform — VC fund administration/secondaries; long-open VC fund counsel seat
leads.employmentTypeRaw: Venture Capital Fund Attorney (W-2 senior; long-open)
leads.notes: VC-funds ICP fit strong. Same fractional-bridge dynamic as Allocate — long-open senior W-2 posting that supports a 'I'll fill it fractionally while you search' pitch.

leads.name: Contraline
leads.industry: Clinical-stage biopharmaceutical — male contraception (NES/T Gel, hormonal reversible)
leads.fundingStage: $92.5M Series B on 2026-06-02 co-led by BVF Partners and RA Capital Management; GV (Google Ventures), Lumira Ventures, Invus participating. Phase 3 development anticipated 2027.

contacts.name: Iris van Alderwerelt van Rosenburgh, PhD
contacts.title: BVF Partners — joined Contraline board 2026-06-02

leads.notes: Biotech outside FS/tech ICP — track-only / second-touch. Strong PR narrative ('massive white space of men's health') if Mark wants to expand category beyond core ICP. Phase 3 milestone in 2027 creates a future-quarter retainer trigger.
